--- git_gc_weekly.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# weekly: gc of VPS clone only if .git > LIMIT_MB. Run via cron under `timeout 900`; flock released on exit.
REPO=/opt/weather-pipeline/repo; LIMIT_MB=500
S=$(du -sm $REPO/.git | cut -f1)
echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] .git=${S}MB limit=${LIMIT_MB}MB"
if [ "$S" -lt "$LIMIT_MB" ]; then echo "skip (below limit)"; exit 0; fi
i=200
for L in /tmp/vps_pipeline.lock /tmp/vps_satellite_pipeline.lock /tmp/vps_ai_pipeline.lock /tmp/vps_git.lock; do
  i=$((i+1)); eval "exec $i>>$L"
  if ! flock -w 180 $i; then echo "ABORT: could not lock $L"; exit 1; fi
done
cd $REPO || exit 1
git reflog expire --expire=now --all
git gc --prune=now
echo "gc rc=$? after: $(du -sm .git | cut -f1)MB"
